name: Alivio MC18 E-set support-plate front derailleur
weight_description: Not yet sourced: no configuration-specific mass is published for this exact mount. A weighed clamp diameter is not established for the band model, and the support-plate assembly is not treated as a modern direct mount.

technical_document.title: Shimano 2000 STI technical manual, PDF page 56 / printed page 56: exact FD-MC18 / FD-MC18-E columns: 20T capacity, 42T top gear and 10T top/middle minimum

sources.title: Shimano 2000 STI technical manual, PDF page 56 / printed page 56: exact FD-MC18 / FD-MC18-E columns: 20T capacity, 42T top gear and 10T top/middle minimum

specifications.mounting_note: E-set design requires no stabilizer boss or frame additions, according to the 1999 manufacturer feature page.
